description: Repairs r-enc-link/profile-unprotected: the probe opens an accdb_enc role, but create-enc-accdb-enc failed (3001, dbEncrypt is refused for ACCDB), so the fixture is missing and the probe has no retained record. The three files that exist (r-enc-link-enc-mdb-plain, r-enc-link-enc-mdb-enc, r-enc-link-enc-accdb-plain) are opened without a database password read-only with Connect omitted, with a wrong password ';pwd=wrong-pass' and with ';pwd='. DBEngine.Errors is read right before and right after each attempt; an open that works reports counts.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
